name: Bifrost JSF C++ coding standard
description: Buildable JSF C++ coding-standard policies mirrored from the public CodeQL C/C++ query pack.

policies.severity_rationale: A variadic callable has an open-ended argument contract that weakens the JSF interface and review boundary.
policies.remediation: Replace the variadic interface with an explicit parameter contract or document and constrain the accepted arguments.

policies.severity_rationale: A callable with more than seven parameters is difficult to invoke and review consistently.
policies.remediation: Group related inputs into a reviewed value object or split the callable while preserving its contract.

policies.severity_rationale: Wide-character literals introduce portability and representation assumptions that JSF requires reviewers to address.
policies.remediation: Use the project-approved character representation and document any required wide-character boundary.

policies.severity_rationale: Lowercase integer suffixes are a portable-source convention violation under JSF.
policies.remediation: Use the project-approved uppercase literal suffix spelling and preserve the intended literal type.

policies.severity_rationale: Nonzero octal constants are easy to misread and have implementation-sensitive intent.
policies.remediation: Replace the octal spelling with an explicit decimal or hexadecimal constant after reviewing its intended value.

policies.severity_rationale: Lowercase hexadecimal digits reduce consistency of constants in a safety-oriented codebase.
policies.remediation: Use the project-approved uppercase hexadecimal spelling after confirming the constant value.

policies.severity_rationale: Overloading logical or address-of operators can obscure evaluation and ownership semantics at every call site.
policies.remediation: Remove the overload or replace it with an explicitly named operation after reviewing all callers.

policies.severity_rationale: The locale C library interface introduces global locale state and portability concerns in JSF code.
policies.remediation: Use the project-approved locale abstraction or document and isolate the required locale boundary.

policies.severity_rationale: C++ exception paths complicate bounded failure handling and are prohibited by this JSF rule.
policies.remediation: Replace exception-based transfer with the project's explicit error contract and review every affected exit path.

policies.severity_rationale: Unqualified basic arithmetic types can vary in width and representation across targets.
policies.remediation: Use the project's fixed-width or reviewed domain type after confirming the required range and conversion behavior.

policies.severity_rationale: The C signal interface creates global asynchronous control behavior outside the preferred JSF execution model.
policies.remediation: Use the project-approved signal abstraction or isolate and document the required signal boundary.

policies.severity_rationale: The stdio interface bypasses the reviewed I/O abstraction and can weaken portability and resource review.
policies.remediation: Use the project-approved I/O abstraction or document and isolate the required stdio boundary.

policies.severity_rationale: The time C library interface introduces platform-specific time behavior outside the reviewed JSF surface.
policies.remediation: Use the project-approved time abstraction or isolate and document the required time.h boundary.

policies.severity_rationale: Invalid include filename sequences can make preprocessing ambiguous or nonportable.
policies.remediation: Rename the header to a portable filename and use a valid include spelling.
